machine_profile.summary: Generic template for chemical and fertiliser process equipment: spray dryers, granulators, distillation columns, decanter centrifuges and filter presses.
machine_profile.typical_duty: Continuous or campaign operation with hazardous or flammable materials, under process-safety management.

operating_parameters.label: Dryer inlet air temperature
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Set by the product; overshoot risks dust explosion and product damage.

operating_parameters.label: Dryer outlet temperature
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Controls the product moisture and drying efficiency.

operating_parameters.label: Feed solids content
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Low solids mean more water to evaporate and more energy.

operating_parameters.label: Column differential pressure
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: A rise signals flooding or fouling.

operating_parameters.label: Reflux ratio
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: A higher ratio than needed wastes reboiler steam.

operating_parameters.label: Agitator motor current
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: A rise signals bearing wear or viscosity changes.

operating_parameters.label: Vent VOC concentration
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: Solvent loss is both a pollution and a cost.

operating_parameters.label: Filtrate turbidity
operating_parameters.why_it_matters: High turbidity means cloth failure and solids carry-over.

job_types.name: Thermal insulation and cladding repair
job_types.trigger: Hot or cold spots at a thermal survey, or annually
checklist: Seal the cladding joints against water ingress
safety_and_permit_notes: Asbestos check on old lagging before removal

job_types.name: Heat-exchanger cleaning
job_types.trigger: Fouling factor above design, or per campaign
checklist: Hydro-jet or chemically clean the tubes
safety_and_permit_notes: Lock-out / tag-out and zero-energy verification before opening

job_types.name: Process pump mechanical-seal replacement
checklist: Isolate, drain, purge and verify gas-free
safety_and_permit_notes: Lock-out / tag-out and zero-energy verification before opening

job_types.name: Relief valve test and recertification
job_types.trigger: Valve weeping or the test interval reached
checklist: Isolate with a car-sealed block valve per procedure
Remove and bench-test the set pressure
Lap the seat or replace the internals
safety_and_permit_notes: Never isolate a relief valve without a management-of-change approval
Lock-out / tag-out and zero-energy verification before opening

job_types.name: Agitator or gearbox bearing replacement
checklist: Remove the gearbox or bearing housing
safety_and_permit_notes: Lock-out / tag-out and zero-energy verification before opening

job_types.name: Filter cloth change
job_types.trigger: Turbidity above the limit or a cycle-time increase
checklist: Run a test cycle and check turbidity

job_types.name: Leak detection and repair (LDAR) survey
checklist: Survey flanges, valves, pumps and seals with a VOC analyser

job_types.name: Atomiser wheel inspection and balancing
job_types.trigger: Vibration rising, or by running hours
checklist: Inspect the wheel inserts for wear
safety_and_permit_notes: Lock-out / tag-out and zero-energy verification before opening

job_types.name: Dryer bag filter service
job_types.trigger: Product loss at the stack, or dP out of range
safety_and_permit_notes: Confined-space entry permit, gas test and standby attendant

job_types.name: Decanter scroll and bowl overhaul
safety_and_permit_notes: Lock-out / tag-out and zero-energy verification before opening

job_types.name: Granulator drum build-up removal
job_types.trigger: Drum current high or product size off spec
checklist: Inspect the flights and the scrapers
Restart and check the granule size
safety_and_permit_notes: Lock-out / tag-out and zero-energy verification before opening
Confined-space entry permit, gas test and standby attendant

job_types.name: Secondary containment bund repair
checklist: Repair cracks with chemical-resistant mortar or lining

snag_types.name: Insulation wear
symptoms: Surface temperature above 60 C over a large area
snag_types.detection_method: Thermal-camera survey and touch-safe surface checks

severity_levels.definition: First sign of insulation wear: warm cladding surface noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: warm cladding surface confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: damaged or wet lagging; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: surface temperature above 60 c over a large area; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the surface temperature exceeds 80 C where people pass

snag_types.immediate_action: Mark the area, fit temporary guarding if the surface is hot, and book a repair
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the surface temperature exceeds 80 C where people pass

pollution_effects.effect: Heat loss raises fuel use and CO2.
Cold spots can condense corrosive vapours inside the duct.

snag_types.name: Heat-exchanger fouling

severity_levels.definition: First sign of heat-exchanger fouling: reduced outlet temperature noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: reduced outlet temperature confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: higher steam or fuel demand; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: pressure drop above design; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the process temperature cannot be met

snag_types.immediate_action: Lower the throughput if the product spec is at risk and plan cleaning
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the process temperature cannot be met

pollution_effects.effect: Extra steam raises CO2.
Cleaning waste must go to treatment.

snag_types.name: Process pump mechanical-seal failure
symptoms: Spray of process fluid or vapour
snag_types.detection_method: Seal-pot alarms and walk-round checks with a gas detector

severity_levels.definition: First sign of process pump mechanical-seal failure: seal-pot level change noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: seal-pot level change confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: drips at the seal; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: spray of process fluid or vapour; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate at once if the gas detector alarms or the fluid is toxic

snag_types.immediate_action: Switch to the standby pump and isolate the leaking one
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate at once if the gas detector alarms or the fluid is toxic

pollution_effects.effect: Process chemical release.
VOC emissions from volatile fluids.
Spills outside the bund reach the ground.

snag_types.name: Relief valve weeping
symptoms: Vapour or liquid at the relief valve discharge
Flare or vent flow when the system is below the set pressure
root_causes: Operating too close to the set pressure
snag_types.detection_method: Tail-pipe temperature or acoustic monitor; flare flow meter

severity_levels.definition: First sign of relief valve weeping: vapour or liquid at the relief valve discharge noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: vapour or liquid at the relief valve discharge confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: flare or vent flow when the system is below the set pressure; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: continuous release or chattering; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate to process safety immediately; never isolate without approval

snag_types.immediate_action: Lower the operating pressure margin per procedure and inform process safety
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate to process safety immediately; never isolate without approval

pollution_effects.effect: Vented vapour adds VOC and greenhouse emissions.
Loss of containment of process chemical.

snag_types.name: Agitator bearing wear
snag_types.detection_method: Vibration and temperature checks per round

severity_levels.definition: First sign of agitator bearing wear: rising motor current noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: rising motor current confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: noise and vibration; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: hot gearbox or bearing housing; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the bearing temperature exceeds 90 C

snag_types.immediate_action: Reduce the batch load if possible and plan a bearing change
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the bearing temperature exceeds 90 C

pollution_effects.effect: Seal damage from shaft run-out can release vessel contents.

snag_types.name: Filter cloth blinding
snag_types.detection_method: Cycle time and filtrate turbidity per batch

severity_levels.definition: First sign of filter cloth blinding: longer filtration cycle noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: longer filtration cycle confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: wet cake; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: cloudy filtrate or torn cloth; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if filtrate solids go to the effluent above the limit

snag_types.immediate_action: Wash the cloths and check the feed conditioning
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if filtrate solids go to the effluent above the limit

pollution_effects.effect: Solids and COD in the filtrate raise the effluent load.
Wetter cake increases the disposal mass.

snag_types.name: Solvent vapour leak
symptoms: VOC reading above the threshold at flanges
snag_types.detection_method: LDAR survey with a VOC analyser

severity_levels.definition: First sign of solvent vapour leak: solvent odour noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: solvent odour confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: voc reading above the threshold at flanges; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: gas detector alarm; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the reading exceeds 25% of the lower explosive limit

snag_types.immediate_action: Ventilate, remove ignition sources, and isolate the source
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the reading exceeds 25% of the lower explosive limit

pollution_effects.effect: VOC emissions.
Solvent loss and exposure.

snag_types.name: Atomiser wheel imbalance
symptoms: Wall deposits in the chamber and vibration trips
snag_types.detection_method: Vibration trend and product particle size

severity_levels.definition: First sign of atomiser wheel imbalance: rising atomiser vibration noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: rising atomiser vibration confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: coarser particles; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: wall deposits in the chamber and vibration trips; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate on any vibration trip

snag_types.immediate_action: Reduce the feed rate and plan an atomiser swap

pollution_effects.effect: Wet deposits cause more drying energy and fines to the bag filter.

snag_types.name: Dryer bag filter leak

severity_levels.definition: First sign of dryer bag filter leak: product dust at the stack noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: product dust at the stack confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: dp drop; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: visible plume or deposits; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if a permit limit is at risk

snag_types.immediate_action: Isolate the compartment if possible and inform EHS
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if a permit limit is at risk

pollution_effects.effect: Particulate emissions.
Product dust deposits around the site.

snag_types.name: Decanter scroll wear
snag_types.detection_method: Cake dryness and centrate solids per shift

severity_levels.definition: First sign of decanter scroll wear: wetter cake noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: wetter cake confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: higher solids in the centrate; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: vibration or torque alarms; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate on a vibration trip

snag_types.immediate_action: Lower the feed rate and plan an overhaul

pollution_effects.effect: Solids carry-over raises the effluent load.
Wetter cake increases sludge disposal.

snag_types.name: Granulator drum build-up
snag_types.detection_method: Drum current and the granule size distribution

severity_levels.definition: First sign of granulator drum build-up: rising drum current noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: rising drum current confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: off-size granules; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: lumps blocking the discharge; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the discharge blocks

snag_types.immediate_action: Adjust the liquid-to-solid ratio and plan cleaning

pollution_effects.effect: Ammonia and dust emissions rise with poor granulation.
Off-spec product becomes waste.

snag_types.name: Reboiler tube leak
symptoms: Process fluid in the steam system

severity_levels.definition: First sign of reboiler tube leak: process contamination of the condensate noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: process contamination of the condensate confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: pressure changes; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: process fluid in the steam system; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if the process fluid enters the utility steam

snag_types.immediate_action: Divert the condensate to the drain safely and plan isolation
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if the process fluid enters the utility steam

pollution_effects.effect: Contaminated condensate to the drain.
Process chemical crosses into the utilities.

snag_types.name: Containment bund crack
symptoms: Liquid in the bund that does not drain
snag_types.detection_method: Monthly visual check and annual hydro-test

severity_levels.definition: First sign of containment bund crack: hairline cracks noticed at inspection; no measurable effect on output, energy use or emissions. Log it and watch at the next round.
Minor: hairline cracks confirmed; energy or quality penalty under about 2%. Plan the repair job for the next planned stop.
Moderate: liquid in the bund that does not drain; fuel use, emissions or product quality measurably worse. Repair within 7 days and check every shift.
Serious: ground staining outside the bund; a process, safety or permit limit is at risk. Repair within 48 hours and inform the shift supervisor.
Severe or failing: trip, damage or a permit breach is imminent. Stop the machine safely, isolate, and escalate: escalate if staining appears outside the bund

snag_types.immediate_action: Keep the bund empty and plan a repair
snag_types.escalation_criteria: Escalate if staining appears outside the bund

pollution_effects.effect: Leakage to ground contaminates soil.
Seepage can reach groundwater.
